activity.notes: György Dózsa was appointed commander of a crusading force on 24 April 1514; the movement rapidly became a major peasant uprising against the Hungarian nobility. The first attempt was blocked because 'opposes' cannot be a person's primary Activity; a second retry using period_basis 'rebellion' was blocked because that code is not in the current Production vocabulary. This final model follows existing revolutionary-leader records such as Sandino and Levski: Dózsa is active in the Hungarian Peasant Uprising of 1514 with general_activity as the supported period basis.

sources.title: Crusading as Social Revolt: The Hungarian Peasant Uprising of 1514 — Cambridge Core
sources.citation_text: Norman Housley's study records Dózsa's appointment as commander on 24 April 1514 and the transformation of the crusade into the Hungarian peasant uprising.
